decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-19 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-06-02, granted approval for the introduction of a new Act to establish the National Agency for Public Private Partnership and to provide the legal provisions for promoting and facilitating Public Private Partnerships in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the relevant Bill has been drafted by the Legal Draftsman, and legal clearance has been granted by the Attorney General for the same. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning, and Economic Development, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
